notes.title: Brand-new Patch is Out Now!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We're bringing you a new patch that not only fixes some nasty bugs that we were able to locate thanks to your reports, but also slightly rebalances the game and adds some miscellaneous settings, such as arachnophobia mode!  

Thank you all for keeping your eyes open and for sharing your feedback with us! Please, keep doing so on our [url=https://discord.gg/pkqDCFg6dj]Discord[/url] server, we're looking forward to seeing you there.

[h3][b]Change Log:[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] In a recent update, several changes have been made to Phaedra's abilities in the game:
[list]
[*] Tornado Damage Reduced - Phaedra's own tornadoes will no longer damage her.
[*] Wind Sphere Damage Nerfed - The damage from Phaedra's Wind Sphere ability has been slightly reduced.
[*] Spider Projectiles More Visible - The spider projectiles fired by Phaedra are now larger, have a modified color, and move slower, making them more visible to players.
[*] Blunderbuss Spread Narrowed - The spread of Phaedra's Blunderbuss attack has been reduced.
[/list]
[*] New Miscellaneous Options
[list]
[*] A new "Pistol Start" mode has been added to the miscellaneous options menu.
[/list]
[*] Arachnophobia Mode Added
[list]
[*] An "Arachnophobia mode" has been introduced, which replaces Phaedra's spider minions with a Swamp Serpent morph for players who aren't fans of spiders.
[/list]
[*] Audio Improvements
[list]
[*] A volume slider for pickups has been added to the audio settings.
[/list]
[*] Bug Fixes
[list]
[*] Other minor bug fixes and improvements have been made to the game.
[/list]
[/list]

notes.notes:
Following on from the positively rated Hands of Necromancy, HON Team and Fulqrum Publishing are back bringing you more Heretic and Doom styled fun in Hands of Necromancy II.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2024/09/dark-fantasy-fps-fans-should-check-out-hands-of-necromancy-ii

notes.title: New retro FPS Hands of Necromancy 2 looks to Heretic for inspiration
notes.notes:
Fantasy and gaming often goes hand in hand, with The Witcher, Elder Scrolls, Baldur's Gate, and Dragon Age being the pillars of the genre. Despite that, fantasy and FPS games often struggle - with only Hexen, Heretic, and Amid Evil really making an impact on the wider world of gaming. Thankfully there are some developers who are still willing to try and crack the fantasy nut, and sequel Hands of Necromancy 2 is here to give it a go.

Read the rest of the story...
